decisions.reason: The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already captures the revised copy stating that active prize tickets transfer with a sold NFT; no additional Event is needed.
Transfer of active tickets between NFT owners does not change the wallet or dashboard access requirements for fiat buyers.
Transferring active tickets does not change the one-click prize claim method, Winners page announcement, or claim URL.
Ticket ownership after an NFT transfer does not alter the allocation of primary-sale revenue or fiat fees.
The source change concerns active prize tickets, not the mint number's identity, permanence, or display as the referral code.
The transfer of existing active tickets does not change how a commission is assigned when a mint has no referral code.
Active Big Block tickets changing owners with the NFT does not modify ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, reset, prize amounts, or draw triggers.
Transfer of active tickets does not change the flat secondary royalty, founder allocation, pool funding, or rule that secondary sales generate no referral tickets.
NFT ticket-transfer semantics do not affect Transak, supported fiat payment methods, conversion assets, or preexisting wallet requirements for minting.
The NFT transfer rule is unrelated to blocking access to the landing page from Mauritius.
The metadata requirement to display Small and Big Block ticket counters remains valid unchanged; ownership transfer of their active values is separately represented by the source Requirement.
Active Small Block tickets changing owners with the NFT does not modify the prize amount, draw condition, pool funding, or other Small Block mechanics.
